The one page a judge or teammate opens to reproduce Holdline from a cold clone.

## Fresh-clone verify
No keys, no network, no on-chain state:
```
git clone https://github.com/dmustapha/holdline.git && cd holdline && npm install && npm test
```
Expected output: `18/18` core tests pass (LTV trigger math, market-hours, trigger-boundary, IDL structure).

Design tests (also from a clean clone):
```
cd app && npm install && npm run test:teeth
```
Expected output: `34/34` design tests pass (token-drift, forbidden-defaults, WCAG contrast >= 4.5:1).

The full unattended-repay flow and the six custody controls run against a mainnet fork you boot yourself; the pinned Solana toolchain (`solana-install 2.3.0`, `anchor 0.32`) is required for that path only. Steps: repo README ["Run the full protective flow"](README.md#run-the-full-protective-flow-mainnet-fork). `node_modules/.bin/ts-node scripts/control-hardening.ts` prints `ALL HARDENING CONTROLS PASSED`.
